Donald J. Trump
biography: Donald John Trump is an American businessman, media personality, and politician who served as the 45th U.S. president from 2017 to 2021 and is currently serving as the 47th U.S. president since 2025. Born in Queens, New York, he followed in his father's footsteps into real estate development, eventually taking over the family business and renaming it the Trump Organization. He built a global brand that included hotels, casinos, and golf courses, and gained further fame as a television personality. He entered politics with his 2016 presidential campaign, winning the election as a Republican. He is the second president to serve non-consecutive terms.
